title: This time next year - resolutions, mindset & planning

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到超出出卖时间换金钱的收入，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特（Marianne Trent）博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将自己的专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，从那以后，我也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南和梅森（Fortnum and Mason）的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客陪着你，你将走上由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持的《有志心理学家播客》的道路。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Wishing you the happiest of happy new years.
sentences.zh: 祝你度过一个快乐之至的新年。

sentences.en: Welcome to 2023.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到2023年。

sentences.en: Does it look like you thought it would?
sentences.zh: 它看起来和你想象的一样吗？

sentences.en: And I guess, yeah, today, as I record this just before Christmas, this feels like a time of reflection for me.
sentences.zh: 我想，是的，今天，当我在这就在圣诞节前录制的时候，这让我感觉是一个反思的时刻。

sentences.en: So I'm recording this on the 19th of December and the 20th of December will be five years since my dad died.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在12月19日录制的，12月20日将是我父亲去世五周年。

sentences.en: And it always feels like a kind of nice chance to be able to reflect on what's come and gone in those five years.
sentences.zh: 这总是感觉像是一个很好的机会，能够反思在这五年里发生了什么，又失去了什么。

sentences.en: And of course, I lost a great deal when I lost my dad, as you might well be aware, if you've also lost a parent or someone significant to you.
sentences.zh: 当然，当我失去父亲时，我失去了很多，正如你可能很清楚的那样，如果你也失去过父母或对你很重要的人。

sentences.en: But there have also been great things that have come since my dad died and things that when you're in the middle of grief can feel tricky to even imagine that that would happen.
sentences.zh: 但自从我父亲去世后，也发生了很多伟大的事情，有些事情在当你处于悲伤之中时，甚至很难想象这些会发生。

sentences.en: I would never have imagined that I would become self-employed, let alone fully self-employed, which my dad was actually from when I was around 10 or 11, I think,
sentences.zh: 我从未想象过我会成为自由职业者，更不用说完全自主创业了，我父亲其实在我10岁或11岁左右的时候就开始这样了，我想，

sentences.en: until shortly before he died.
sentences.zh: 直到他去世前不久。

sentences.en: He retired when he was 69.
sentences.zh: 他在69岁时退休。

sentences.en: And so I would have liked to have had a chat with him about what being self-employed was like.
sentences.zh: 所以我也许会想和他聊聊身为自由职业者是什么体验。

sentences.en: And that's something that I won't ever get a chance to do.
sentences.zh: 而这是我永远不会有机会做的事情。

sentences.en: But I definitely got an understanding of what he was all about and what being self-employed meant to him and that he'd get his books out on a on a Sunday evening in the kitchen when it was quiet.
sentences.zh: 但我确实理解了他究竟是一个什么样的人，自由职业对他的意义，以及他在周日晚上安静的时候会把账本拿出来在厨房里看。

sentences.en: And he'd go through them there whilst eating cheese and crackers.
sentences.zh: 他会在那里一边吃着奶酪饼干一边查阅账目。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I definitely got the idea that being self-employed is about working flexibly.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我绝对明白了一个道理，那就是自由职业意味着弹性工作。

sentences.en: What have you achieved in the last year?
sentences.zh: 你在过去的一年里取得了什么成就？

sentences.en: What would you like to see yourself achieve in the next year?
sentences.zh: 你希望自己在接下来的一年里取得什么成就？

sentences.en: This has been prompted for me today because I had my yearly email sent to me from me.
sentences.zh: 今天我之所以有感而发，是因为我收到了自己发给自己的一封年度邮件。

sentences.en: So it's something I set up via a website called Future Me, and there will be details in the show notes of how you can find that.
sentences.zh: 这是我通过一个叫“未来的我”（Future Me）的网站设置的，节目说明里会有如何找到它的详细信息。

sentences.en: If you Google Future Me, you should find it.
sentences.zh: 如果你在谷歌上搜索“未来的我”，你应该就能找到它。

sentences.en: And basically, you can write yourself a little letter that will be emailed out to you at a specific time and date.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你可以给自己写一封小信，它会在特定的时间和日期通过电子邮件发给你。

sentences.en: And so I forget about it every year.
sentences.zh: 所以我每年都会把它忘得精光。

sentences.en: And then I see it in my emails that I've got an email from myself, Future Me.
sentences.zh: 然后我在邮件里看到我收到了一封来自我自己的邮件，也就是未来的我。

sentences.en: And it's really nice to be able to reflect on where you were last year.
sentences.zh: 能够反思你去年在哪里，这真的是一种很好的体验。

sentences.en: But then I've written my one for next year.
sentences.zh: 然后我已经写好了给明年的信。

sentences.en: So it will arrive with me on the 19th of December 2023.
sentences.zh: 所以它将会在2023年12月19日到达我手中。

sentences.en: So it's got my hopes.
sentences.zh: 里面有我的希望。

sentences.en: It's got my dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 里面有我的梦想。

sentences.en: It's got a bit of a recap about where I've been this year because we can so easily forget.
sentences.zh: 它包含了一份关于我今年去过哪里的简短回顾，因为我们太容易遗忘了。

sentences.en: So is that something you could think about doing?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是你可以考虑去做的事情吗？

sentences.en: And if you did, what would be in it?
sentences.zh: 如果你这样做了，里面会写些什么呢？

sentences.en: You know, would you celebrate things that have happened this year?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你会庆祝今年发生的事情吗？

sentences.en: Would you, you know, commiserate and be sad and be compassionate to yourself for things that have happened this year or that haven't happened this year?
sentences.zh: 你会，你知道的，为今年发生的事情或没有发生的事情感到痛心、难过，并对自己充满同情吗？

sentences.en: We all still lost a great deal from COVID, even if people we know didn't die from it.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人其实都因为新冠疫情失去了很多，即使我们认识的人并没有因此离世。

sentences.en: There were sacrifices to pay for many of us with things that didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 对我们许多人来说，为了那些未能实现的愿望，我们付出了牺牲的代价。

sentences.en: Are you still wheeling from that?
sentences.zh: 你现在还在为那段经历而心有余悸吗？

sentences.en: Are there things that, you know, you would like to have be different next year?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么事情，你知道的，你希望在明年有所改变？

sentences.en: And given that you might well be an aspiring psychologist or working in mental health, there might be things that you'd like to achieve in your career next year.
sentences.zh: 鉴于你很可能是一名有志的心理学家或在心理健康领域工作，明年你在职业生涯中可能有一些想要实现的成就。

sentences.en: So if you are an aspiring psychologist, perhaps you'd like to imagine that you might be on a doctorate by this time next year.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是一名有志的心理学家，也许你会想象，到明年的这个时候，你可能已经在攻读博士学位了。

sentences.en: So your doctorate might have started in September or you might have had some really useful experiences at interview.
sentences.zh: 所以你的博士学位可能已经在9月份开始了，或者你在面试中获得了一些非常宝贵的经验。

sentences.en: Or you might be really feeling like you've gained the relevant skills and experience for you to be able to stand a much stronger chance.
sentences.zh: 或者你真的觉得你已经获得了相关的技能和经验，从而能够拥有更大的胜算。

sentences.en: Maybe you're able to say to yourself, yes, I believe it's my time and I am ready for this next step this year in 2023.
sentences.zh: 也许你能对自己说，是的，我相信属于我的时机已到，我已经准备好在今年2023年迈出这下一步了。

sentences.en: Because I do honestly believe that is what I would have said to myself and probably was saying to myself,
sentences.zh: 因为我真的相信，这就是我当时会对自己说的话，而且可能也确实在对自己说，

sentences.en: but not perhaps quite as directly as that in 2007 when I was, you know, I guess I'd already submitted my form, which was successful.
sentences.zh: 只不过在2007年的时候可能没有那么直接，当时，你知道的，我想我已经提交了申请表，而且成功了。

sentences.en: I didn't know that yet, but I did feel it.
sentences.zh: 我当时还不知道结果，但我确实有这种感觉。

sentences.en: I felt like hopeful.
sentences.zh: 我感到充满希望。

sentences.en: I felt like I was in the right headspace and that I had the right experiences that I was able to draw and reflect on in a great way that would hopefully, I just felt confident,
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己处于正确的心态中，并且拥有合适的经验，我可以从中汲取并进行极好的反思，希望……我只是感到自信，

sentences.en: you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: And so that's been something that's been really lovely to nurture people with in the aspiring psychologist membership, which is something which didn't exist this time last year.
sentences.zh: 所以，在“有志心理学家会员群”里用这些来滋养大家，一直是一件非常美好的事情，这个群在去年这个时候还不存在。

sentences.en: It was born on the 28th of February, 2022.
sentences.zh: 它诞生于2022年2月28日。

sentences.en: That's when we welcomed our first cohort of members in.
sentences.zh: 那是我们迎接第一批会员加入的日子。

sentences.en: And it's been the loveliest membership to champion, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这一直是让人感觉最美好的、值得捍卫的会员群体。

sentences.en: People say really lovely things about it.
sentences.zh: 大家对它赞不绝口。

sentences.en: So if you're thinking, oh, maybe 2023 might bring me more people that understand where I'm at.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在想，哦，也许2023年会给我带来更多理解我处境的人。

sentences.en: Maybe it might bring me, you know, more CBT teaching skills and formulation.
sentences.zh: 也许它会带给我，你知道的，更多的CBT（认知行为疗法）教学技能和个案概念化。

sentences.en: Maybe it might increase my skills and understanding in a number of areas, you know, including cognitive analytic therapy, psychodynamic, motivational interviewing.
sentences.zh: 也许它会提升我在多个领域的技能和理解，你知道的，包括认知分析疗法、心理动力学、 motivational interviewing（动机式访谈）。

sentences.en: You know, maybe there's reflective practice stuff that you'd like to increase your skills and confidence in.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，也许有些反思实践的内容是你希望提升技能和自信心的。

sentences.en: Then do come on board to the aspiring psychologist membership, which you can get for £30 a month and you can cancel any time.
sentences.zh: 那就快来加入“有志心理学家会员群”吧，你只需每月支付30英镑，而且随时可以取消。

sentences.en: So if you want to dive in for a month and see what it's like, see whether it works for you, then absolutely do that.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想加入一个月看看它是什么样的，看看它是否适合你，那就绝对去试试吧。

sentences.en: And you can watch stuff on replay if you don't want to watch it live or you can do both.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想看直播，你可以看回放，或者两者兼顾。

sentences.en: You can watch things live.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看直播。

sentences.en: You can watch things on replay.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看回放。

sentences.en: And there's your weekly chance to ask me any questions as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是你每周有机会向我提出任何问题的时候。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'm at your beckoned call.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我随叫随到。

sentences.en: So do consider that.
sentences.zh: 所以请认真考虑一下。

sentences.en: But in the last year, we also had the birth of the Aspiring Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 但在过去的一年里，我们还迎来了《有志心理学家合集》这本书的诞生。

sentences.en: And that, again, has been lovely.
sentences.zh: 同样，这也非常棒。

sentences.en: And hearing people say that they really like that, they like feeling validated and normalised in their experiences.
sentences.zh: 听到大家说他们真的很喜欢这本书，他们喜欢在自己的经历中感受到被认可和被赋能的感觉。

sentences.en: And people are still saying lovely things about the Clinical Psychologist Collective too.
sentences.zh: 而且人们对《临床心理学家合集》也依然赞不绝口。

sentences.en: So, honestly, when I decided to leave employed life in April 2021, well, I decided in January 2021, and then I had to wait out my notice period.
sentences.zh: 所以，老实说，当我决定在2021年4月离开职场时——嗯，我是2021年1月决定的，然后我不得不等待我的离职通知期。

sentences.en: So when I decided, you know, it was two years ago, I decided very almoSt.
sentences.zh: 所以当我做出决定时，你知道，那是两年前，我几乎是瞬间决定的。

sentences.en: I couldn't have imagined that I'd be enjoying life this much, you know.
sentences.zh: 我以前怎么也想不到自己会如此享受生活，你知道的。

sentences.en: And that's what I would like you to be thinking as well this time next year.
sentences.zh: 这也是我希望你在明年的这个时候也能思考的事情。

sentences.en: You know, I couldn't have imagined that it would feel this good to be doing what I'm doing right now.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我以前无法想象做我现在正在做的事情感觉会这么好。

sentences.en: And I've always enjoyed what I've done.
sentences.zh: 而且我一直都很享受我所做的事情。

sentences.en: It's not like I was having a horrid time.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我以前过得很水深火热。

sentences.en: It's just that I was really liking the opportunity to be able to work flexibly and quickly and responsibly.
sentences.zh: 只是我真的很喜欢能够灵活、快速且负责任地工作的机会。

sentences.en: So that was part of my decision to leave and to go all in because I wanted to be able to support you guys in new, different, creative ways that took more of my time as well.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是我决定离开并全力以赴的一部分原因，因为我希望能够以崭新的、不同的、有创意的方式支持你们，这也占据了我更多的时间。

sentences.en: And, of course, that allowed the podcast to be born as well.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也让播客得以诞生。

sentences.en: We have now celebrated, but we're about to celebrate, as I record this, our one-year anniversary.
sentences.zh: 当我们录制这个节目时，我们已经庆祝了，或者正要庆祝我们的一周年纪念日。

sentences.en: So as you were listening to this, this happened on the 24th of December.
sentences.zh: 所以当你听到这个节目时，这是在12月24日发生的。

sentences.en: That was our one-year anniversary.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的一周年纪念日。

sentences.en: And it's just lovely.
sentences.zh: 这简直太美妙了。

sentences.en: I know I keep saying lovely, but it is.
sentences.zh: 我知道我一直在说美妙，但它确实如此。

sentences.en: Like, you know, working with you guys who are really eager and excited and hungry for information but grateful for information too.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，与你们这些真正渴望、兴奋、渴望知识但同时也对知识心怀感激的人一起工作。

sentences.en: You're just a really nice, you know, group of people to work with.
sentences.zh: 你们真的是一群非常棒的、你知道的、很好合作的人。

sentences.en: So if you enjoy what I do, as ever, please do consider leaving me a review on Apple Podcasts.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你喜欢我做的事情，一如既往，请考虑在苹果播客上给我留个好评。

sentences.en: Or if you'd like to come on and do a testimonial for the podcast or any of the books, then please do check out the details in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 或者，如果你想来为播客或任何一本书做个证言，请查看节目说明中的详细信息。

sentences.en: Let's take a quick break here and I'll be back on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里稍作休息，稍后我会回来。

sentences.en: The Clinical Psychologist Collective Book was a very helpful read and useful to step outside of the prep work for the DeClinSci application process.
sentences.zh: 《临床心理学家合集》这本书是一本非常有益的读物，对于跳出DeClinSci（临床心理学博士）申请流程的准备工作来说很有用。

sentences.en: To really consider if this is something you want to do and reflect on your personal journey.
sentences.zh: 去认真思考这是否是你想要做的事情，并反思你个人的心路历程。

sentences.en: It is a very nice read and kept me company on train journeys.
sentences.zh: 这是一本非常不错的书，在我的火车旅途中陪伴着我。

sentences.en: I do think Marianne's guidance through her podcast, Compassionate Q&A Sessions, and this book has played a part in my successful application this year.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为玛丽安通过她的播客、富有同情心的问答环节以及这本书，在我和今年申请成功这件事上发挥了作用。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Okie dokie, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 好嘞，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: So let's think about the practice of New Year's resolutions.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们来想想新年决心的做法。

sentences.en: And I guess I think about it as being perhaps a way to set your intentions.
sentences.zh: 我想我把它看作是一种设定意图的方式。

sentences.en: But let's not go too wild.
sentences.zh: 但我们不要太疯狂。

sentences.en: Let's not change too many things at once.
sentences.zh: 我们不要一次改变太多事情。

sentences.en: You know, you might want to pick one area of your life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可能想选择你生活中的一个领域。

sentences.en: So that might be personal.
sentences.zh: 这可能是个人的。

sentences.en: It might be professional.
sentences.zh: 这可能是职业的。

sentences.en: It might be, you know, the way you nourish yourself.
sentences.zh: 这可能是，你知道的，你滋养自己的方式。

sentences.en: Or the way that you move your body.
sentences.zh: 或者是你活动身体的方式。

sentences.en: And maybe that's something that you can strive for.
sentences.zh: 也许这是你可以为之奋斗的目标。

sentences.en: Just one area to begin with.
sentences.zh: 首先只选一个领域。

sentences.en: And really look at, you know, what we talk about this SMART goals.
sentences.zh: 并真正审视，你知道的，我们所讨论的SMART目标。

sentences.en: So specific, measurable, achievable, realistic and time focused.
sentences.zh: 即具体的、可衡量的、可实现的、现实的和有时间限制的。

sentences.en: And the theory is, if we can do things for 100 days, then it becomes a habit.
sentences.zh: 理论是，如果我们能坚持做一件事100天，那么它就会变成一种习惯。

sentences.en: Then it's something that we integrate into the way that we do things.
sentences.zh: 然后它就会成为我们融入做事方式中的一部分。

sentences.en: So that might look like keeping a reflective journal every day or a few times a week.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来可能像是每天或一周几次写反思日志。

sentences.en: Building that into your regular schedule.
sentences.zh: 把它融入你的日常日程中。

sentences.en: So for me, I tend to edit podcast episodes on Fridays and Mondays and record them then too.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我倾向于在周五和周一剪辑播客节目，并在那时录制它们。

sentences.en: And I might well, if I haven't done my email for the week, I might do that on a Sunday.
sentences.zh: 如果我还没写本周的邮件，我可能会在周日写。

sentences.en: Usually laying down, being quite comfortable.
sentences.zh: 通常是躺着，非常舒适。

sentences.en: Something that becomes predictable and repeatable.
sentences.zh: 一件变得可预测且可重复的事情。

sentences.en: So that it just slots into your life effortlessly.
sentences.zh: 这样它就能毫不费力地融入你的生活。

sentences.en: And that's what we're looking for here.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们在这里所寻找的。

sentences.en: With any intentions or resolutions.
sentences.zh: 关于任何意图或决心。

sentences.en: Things that you're choosing to do from a gestalt perspective.
sentences.zh: 从完形心理学的角度来看，这些是你选择要做的事情。

sentences.en: Rather than feeling like you must or should or got to do.
sentences.zh: 而不是觉得你必须、应该或不得不去做。

sentences.en: So I choose to create this podcast for you.
sentences.zh: 所以我选择为你创建这个播客。

sentences.en: And in doing so, I choose to sacrifice some of my time.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，我选择牺牲我的一些时间。

sentences.en: Because I think that editing it well.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为把它剪辑好。

sentences.en: And doing all the show notes and the transcribing and things is worth it.
sentences.zh: 做所有的节目说明、文字记录和这些事情是值得的。

sentences.en: I'm choosing to do that.
sentences.zh: 我选择这样做。

sentences.en: And therefore, it doesn't feel like I've got to do that.
sentences.zh: 因此，它不会让我觉得我不得不这样做。

sentences.en: And sometimes just that small shift in the way that you think about things from got to, to choose to, can be really transformational for you.
sentences.zh: 有时，仅仅是你对事情的看法从“不得不”到“选择”的微小转变，就能对你产生真正的变革性影响。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, what could you choose to do in 2023 that might enhance your life or an area of your life?
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，在2023年，你可以选择做什么来提升你的生活或你生活的某个领域？

sentences.en: And once you've got your hundred days under your belt, then you might like to think about a new intention rather than cramming it all in at once.
sentences.zh: 一旦你完成了这100天的挑战，你就可以考虑一个新的意图，而不是一下子把它们全塞进去。

sentences.en: Because if we suddenly overwhelm ourselves with, you know, I'm going to get healthy.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我们突然被诸如“我要变得健康”这样的想法压垮。

sentences.en: I'm going to eat really well.
sentences.zh: 我要吃得很好。

sentences.en: I'm going to exercise every day.
sentences.zh: 我要每天锻炼。

sentences.en: I'm going to, you know, get the world's best job.
sentences.zh: 我打算去找到世界上最好的工作。

sentences.en: I'm going to have the world's best relationship.
sentences.zh: 我打算拥有世界上最好的恋爱关系。

sentences.en: I'm going to, you know, do all this published research.
sentences.zh: 我打算去做所有这些已发表的研究。

sentences.en: There's only so many hours in the day and it's going to probably lead to overwhelm and burnout, which might then take a dip on your self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 一天中的时间终究有限，这很可能会导致压力过大和精疲力竭，进而可能会打击你的自尊心。

sentences.en: So let's be kind and compassionate to ourselves.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们对自己好一点，多一点同理心。

sentences.en: Let's be realistic.
sentences.zh: 让我们现实一点。

sentences.en: Let's pick one area.
sentences.zh: 让我们先挑一个领域。

sentences.en: So if you wanted to look into getting some research experience or getting yourself published as a researcher, then what can you do to make that achievable?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你想积累一些研究经验，或者以研究人员的身份发表文章，那么你可以做些什么来让这个目标得以实现呢？

sentences.en: How can you break that down into SMART goals?
sentences.zh: 你如何把它分解成符合SMART原则的目标？

sentences.en: So, yeah, have a think about what you'd like your life to look like next year and just take some moments to plan that out.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，好好想想你希望明年你的生活是什么样的，花点时间把它们规划出来。

sentences.en: Maybe think about writing that letter to yourself as an email on future me and, yeah, just see where you get to and where you'd like to get to by this time next year.
sentences.zh: 或许可以考虑用“未来我”这个邮箱给自己写封信，然后，看看你能走到哪里，以及到明年这个时候你希望自己达到什么状态。

sentences.en: It has been my absolute pleasure to bring all of this content to you over this last year, all of 2022, which has just been wonderful.
sentences.zh: 过去这一年里，也就是整个2022年，能把所有这些内容带给大家，我感到无比的高兴，这段经历实在是太美妙了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world and please do stay in it in 2023.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分，请在2023年继续留在这里。

sentences.en: If you've got any special requests for podcast episodes or if you'd like to come along and discuss something pertinent to you that might appeal to the audience,
sentences.zh: 如果你对播客节目有什么特别的要求，或者你想来讨论一些与你息息相关、可能也会吸引听众的话题，

sentences.en: please do get in contact by going to the podcast page of my website and then there's a little form on there.
sentences.zh: 请访问我网站的播客页面与我联系，上面有一个小表单。

sentences.en: So it's www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk forward slash podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 网址是 www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk 斜杠 podcaSt。

sentences.en: You can also record testimonials for me on there and I should also let you know that the other day I changed my Facebook business page to Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你还可以在上面给我录制听众反馈，我还要告诉大家，前几天我把我的 Facebook 业务主页改成了 Marianne Trent 博士。

sentences.en: So now you can find all of me on all of my socials as Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你可以在我所有的社交平台上以 Marianne Trent 博士的名义找到我。

sentences.en: Everything is consistent.
sentences.zh: 一切都是统一的。

sentences.en: Isn't that marvellous?
sentences.zh: 这不是很棒吗？

sentences.en: So, yeah, come and follow me in all of those places.
sentences.zh: 所以，来这些地方关注我吧。

sentences.en: Just look for Dr. Marianne Trent and you will find me and connect with me and it will be lovely to do so.
sentences.zh: 只需搜索 Marianne Trent 博士，你就能找到我并与我建立联系，这会是一件很棒的事。

sentences.en: I love to celebrate your wins.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢庆祝你们的每一个成就。

sentences.en: So please do connect with me and follow with me on LinkedIn and Instagram as that's where I see most of you and your wins.
sentences.zh: 所以请一定要在 LinkedIn 和 Instagram 上与我联系并关注我，因为在那里我能看到你们大多数人以及你们的成就。

sentences.en: I'm on YouTube, Twitter, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我在 YouTube、Twitter、TikTok、Facebook、Instagram、LinkedIn 上都有账号。

sentences.en: I think that's it.
sentences.zh: 我想就这些了。

sentences.en: I think that's it.
sentences.zh: 我想就这些了。

sentences.en: That's enough, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这就够了，对吧？

sentences.en: That's enough.
sentences.zh: 这就够了。

sentences.en: I am also on Pinterest, but I'm not very good at PintereSt.
sentences.zh: 我也有 Pinterest 账号，但我不太擅长用 Pinterest。

sentences.en: But, yeah, you could follow me on there if you wanted to.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果你愿意的话，也可以在那里关注我。

sentences.en: And I will maybe think about trying to become better on Pinterest in 2023.
sentences.zh: 我可能会考虑在2023年努力把 Pinterest 用得更好一些。

sentences.en: Do you like Pinterest?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢 Pinterest 吗？

sentences.en: I find myself looking at nail designs on there recently.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己最近总是在上面看美甲设计。

sentences.en: But other than that, yeah, I find it hard, hard to know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，说实话，我很难搞懂上面到底有些什么。

sentences.en: It's good for room design ideas and things, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 它用来找房间设计灵感之类的挺不错的，对吧？

sentences.en: But is it good for business?
sentences.zh: 但它对业务有帮助吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Let me know.
sentences.zh: 告诉我吧。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: So, yes, thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 所以，非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Do come along to the free Facebook group, which is the aspiring psychologist community, brackets free group.
sentences.zh: 欢迎加入免费的 Facebook 群组，也就是“有抱负的心理学家社区”（括号里写着免费群组）。

sentences.en: Stay warm this winter.
sentences.zh: 这个冬天注意保暖。

sentences.en: Get the hot water bottles out.
sentences.zh: 把热水袋拿出来吧。

sentences.en: I've been really enjoying those.
sentences.zh: 我最近真的很喜欢用它们。

sentences.en: And, yeah, stay safe.
sentences.zh: 还有，注意安全。

sentences.en: Look after yourself.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己。

sentences.en: Be kind and think about where you'd like to be by this time next year.
sentences.zh: 保持善良，想想到了明年这个时候你想身处何方。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱之外还能赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，我自2019年以来一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现在开始接受报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的成长旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的额外福利以及我个人的独家支持套餐，无需额外付费。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次大师班指导、大师课程、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼品，以及限时的“一对一”教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
